item: routes without a UI caller: generator + ratchet (Lane M)
summary: Source-only sweep of 820 routes against every URL literal in src/static and src/tui; 236 have no UI caller found by the reader, each hand-checked and classed (reader features with no button, ranked and routed to their lanes; a fourth class, unseen, names a caller the reader cannot see). The test fails on a new uncalled route or a stale row and holds the feature count to a zero-slack ceiling.
